result.title: GP--RL--MPC: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control with Gaussian Process Postdecision State-Value Functions
result.comment: 19 pages including references and appendices, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to L4DC 2027
result.summary: We propose Gaussian Process Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control (GP--RL--MPC), which uses a learned critic as the MPC terminal penalty to account for costs beyond the prediction horizon. Gaussian process regression (GPR) enables data-efficient critic learning from limited, noisy rollouts within optimistic approximate policy iteration (OAPI), with soft updates mitigating policy chattering. A tunable risk coefficient weights GP epistemic uncertainty in the terminal cost, regulating sensitivity to uncertain critic predictions. The postdecision state formulation shifts disturbance averaging offline to account for aleatoric uncertainty from the terminal transition onward. Under matching objectives and admissible actions, a one-step horizon recovers greedy value-space RL. After fitting GP hyperparameters by exact marginal likelihood, we construct a sparse deterministic training conditional (DTC) posterior using inducing points selected by pivoted Cholesky (PC), reducing online evaluation costs as the training dataset grows. In a continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) subject to exogenous disturbances, GP--RL--MPC with an appropriately selected risk coefficient and policy screening reduces the sum of squared errors (SSE) by an average of 80.52% relative to an otherwise matched baseline MPC across five random seeds (sample standard deviation: 3.48%).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GP-RL-MPC：用高斯过程学到的 critic 作为 MPC 终端代价以计入时域外成本，在乐观近似策略迭代中数据高效学习，并以可调风险系数加权 GP 认知不确定性、用 postdecision state 处理终端转移的偶然不确定性，再用稀疏 DTC 后验降低在线评估开销；在 CSTR 扰动仿真中相对匹配基线平均降低 80.52% 的 SSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对价值预测的认知不确定性显式加权」与后决策状态更新，可能为 LVR 中基于置信度的证据筛选、停止决策及 latent 状态更新的不确定性建模提供可供核查的思路，但属控制仿真域，迁移性需自行判断。
